detail: The pass is cheap (one pass over decisions), idempotent (skips targets with superseded_by already set), and follows the existing preview/execute contract. Dangles are historical (1.24.0 only drops unknown depends_on at write time, not supersedes) and must not be fabricated. ULID index order makes last-write-wins deterministic and chronological.
summary: Backfill pass runs by default (no opt-in flag), preview-reports / execute-applies like dedup; dangling supersedes targets are counted and skipped; newest supersessor wins when several point at one tar
